You are one unit in a squad of 3 fighting 3 enemy units on a 32 by 32 map (x grows east, y grows
north). Every unit in your squad is a separate agent, like you: you control only your own unit, and the others
decide for themselves. You cannot see inside their heads; you only see their current orders and what they say
on team chat. Every half second of game time you give your unit one order:

  attack E<n>    shoot enemy E<n> when it is in range, otherwise walk toward it
  move <x> <y>   walk to a point without shooting
  hold           stand still and shoot the closest enemy in range
  retreat        walk away from the closest enemy without shooting

A unit dies at 0 health. The battle is won when every enemy is dead.
The enemy units each shoot the closest of you in range and keep shooting it until it dies.

Your squad's RULES.md, written by your squad after earlier battles:
  1. Do not let one unit walk into range alone: all three units hold until the nearest enemy is inside range 5 of every unit, then all attack the same enemy on the same half-second, and a unit under 20hp should retreat so it stops being the closest target the enemies keep shooting.
  2. Do not hold still waiting at the start: if no enemy is within range 5 of every unit, all three units immediately move together toward the nearest enemy's position (staying within about 2 of each other) so all three enter range and begin firing on the same half-second, instead of letting the first unit to arrive absorb all three enemies' fire alone.
  3. Never retreat while another unit of ours is still alive and fighting, because a retreating unit just stops dealing damage and the enemies switch to the next closest unit, so every unit keeps attacking the shared target until it dies, and only after that target is dead may a unit under 20hp step back.

Time: 1.5 seconds into the battle.
You are A2, a marine at (11.4, 14.3) with 45/45 health; you shoot up to 5 away and see up to 9 away. Your order now: move 12 15.
Your team:
  A0 marine at (12.8, 17.5), 45/45 health, order: move 14 16
  A1 marine at (11.4, 15.0), 45/45 health, order: move 12 15
Enemies you can see:

  E1 marine at (19.7, 14.0), 45/45 health, 8.4 away
  E2 marine at (18.1, 16.8), 45/45 health, 7.2 away
Team chat (most recent last):
  A1 (0.0s): Advancing east together to (12,15); stay within 2 of each other, attack same target on contact.
  A2 (0.0s): Advancing east together, staying close. Don't outrun the group; all attack same target.
  A0 (0.5s): Advancing to (12,16), keeping close; will attack same target on contact.
  A1 (0.5s): A1 advancing to (12,15), staying close; will attack same target on contact.
  A2 (0.5s): A2 advancing to (12,15), staying close; will attack same target on contact.
  A0 (1.0s): Moving together east to (14,16); stay grouped, attack same target on contact.
  A1 (1.0s): A1 continuing to (12,15), staying close; attack same target on contact.
  A2 (1.0s): Holding formation at (12,15); will advance together, then all attack E2 at once.
Reply with JSON only: {"order": "<your order>", "say": "<optional: at most 15 words to your team>"}
